sentences.en: Ziri was successful in fooling Rima with his crocodile tears.
sentences.zh: 齐里用假慈悲骗过了里玛。

sentences.en: Can you tell the difference between an alligator and a crocodile?
sentences.zh: 你能分辨出短吻鳄和鳄鱼的区别吗？

sentences.en: Don't be taken in by her crocodile tears.
sentences.zh: 别被她的假慈悲给蒙蔽了。

senses.zh: 鳄鱼,鳄鱼皮革,鳄类动物
